lede: A 1938 home on a fenced, level corner lot in Burien, with a basement that has its own entrance and room to grow.
story: Today it lives as a two-bedroom, one-bath home on the main level, with a partially finished basement and its own separate entrance below. Enjoy it as it is, or look at what the lower level could become: more living space, a rec room, a studio, or possibly an accessory dwelling unit, subject to permits and your own verification.

The lot is just under half an acre, fully fenced, level and on a corner, with fruit trees, garden space, RV parking and outbuildings for storage and hobbies. R2 zoning gives you more to explore over time.
Good to know: the home is on septic. Buyers should verify sewer location, connection and costs, along with zoning and the feasibility of any plans.
